output.title: AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats goes GA; cert-manager Certificates exist here
output.content: The release notes say v1.18.0 promotes the `AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats` feature to GA, so additional formats are always enabled. This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 (Helm, Flux HelmRelease and Argo CD Application), and its manifests include `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` with the `certificates.cert-manager.io` [v1] CRD installed, so the feature's subject is present. The supplied values keys show no feature-gate setting, but the values dimension is only partial, and the excerpt doesn't describe any behaviour change for resources that don't request additional formats. Check whether any Certificate manifests request additional output formats, and whether any controller or webhook feature-gate configuration names this feature, since it is now always on.
